html_source: The Battle of Fontenoy, 1828 oil painting by Horace Vernet, held in the Galerie des Batailles, Palace of Versailles, showing Charles O'Brien, 6th Viscount Clare, presenting a captured British flag to King Louis XV and the dauphin. Source: Wikimedia Commons.

search_text.text:
The Battle of Fontenoy, 1828 oil painting by
  Horace Vernet, held in the Galerie des Batailles, Palace of
  Versailles, showing Charles O'Brien, 6th Viscount Clare,
  presenting a captured British flag to King Louis XV and the
  dauphin. 
  Source: Wikimedia Commons.
